name: Metsu
doc: Fujin's Metsu (enemy attack 215, c0m119 / c0m136, on the party): the blade thrown from the caster's bone past every target and back along a path, spinning and tilting, a fading trail behind it; as it passes each target a hit layout, sparks thrown out, its damage; the caster's weapon hidden meanwhile. Boomerang Sword 304's module on its own path. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag323_metsu.cpp) run on the program's memory (its main, trails, hits and sparks in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Main
parts.doc: The main's ticks, the sound; the texture and the camera

parts.title: Blade
parts.doc: The blade (a model) thrown from the caster's bone past every target and back along a path, spinning and tilting (the caster's weapon object hidden meanwhile); each target's damage as it passes it

parts.title: Trails
parts.doc: A fading copy of the blade left every tick (blue as it fades)

parts.title: Hits
parts.doc: The hit layout at each target passed

parts.title: Sparks
parts.doc: Sparks thrown out of the blade's plane at each hit (a flipbook)
